name: Tsuyoimo x Yowaimo
source:
Main character's family is entrusted with two sisters because their parents can't pay their debt. Protagonist decides to start a cohabitation with his new sisters-in-law. Younger Izumi is a weak girl who is easily humiliated while older Miki has a bully personality, but she is very curious about men.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的家人被托付给两个姐妹，因为她们的父母无力偿还债务。主角决定与他的新嫂子开始同居。年轻的泉是一个很容易被羞辱的软弱女孩，而年长的美木则有着欺负人的性格，但她对男人很好奇。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
